item: The backup route's encrypted-store test pins the lock state the middleware reads, so an expired header cache cannot answer 503 for the ten tests after it
summary: The lock middleware reads the store header through a cache with a 5 s life (connect.main_header_state, keyed by path). test_an_encrypted_store_is_refused_and_leaves_nothing patched is_encrypted_file to True for the route's own refusal; whenever the cache entry had expired inside that request the middleware read the patched value, answered 503 locked, and left the entry for the next nine tests that make a request (ten failures in two of about twelve runs on a busy machine). The test now pins unlock.app_lock_state to unlocked-plaintext and runs with the cache warm (5 s) and expired (life 0, every request is the expired case); with the pin removed the expired case fails the same ten tests (measured: 10 failed, 60 passed, then restored). Test-only: no src change.
